facts.text: Kat's on the phone the whole way down Route 23.
facts.why: Wikipedia only calls Kat a businesswoman who is stopped from entering Route 23. None of the pages I opened say she is on the phone.
facts.fix: Kat's SUV is the one the survivors pile into.

facts.text: Room Key: Last Stop Motel, Room 12, check-out 10am
facts.why: The room key line says check-out 10am, but the key card printed on the same face says Checkout 11. The two times disagree. This is a menu slip, not a film fact.
facts.fix: Room Key: Last Stop Motel, Room 12, check-out 11am

vibe.verdict: A tidy motel postcard, but the log truck, the omens and Bludworth's new life rule are mostly missing from the food.
missing: The log truck pile-up on Route 23 (Kimberly's premonition)
Day-old spaghetti tossed out the window (Evan's death)
Only new life can defeat Death (Bludworth)
Death working backwards through the list (Clear)
The Gibbons family barbecue and the propane grill
ideas: Swap the note on 'Evan's jackpot spaghetti and meatballs' for 'Day-old spaghetti, tossed out the window. Mind the fire escape.'
Swap the note on 'Spring break key lime pie' for 'Only new life can defeat Death. Isabella's baby gets the first slice.'
Swap the note on 'Death's design devilled eggs' for 'Death works backwards. Eat from the end of the plate.'
Swap the house note on 'Frozen lemonade slushie' for 'The Gibbons family barbecue. Stay clear of the propane grill.'
